articles.content: As of November 16, 2026, webatla counts 7,602,144 websites running Elementor, 2.33% of the 325.8 million websites it tracks. The same files hold 23,491,961 WordPress sites, so the Elementor figure is equal to 32.4% of them. That is about one WordPress install in three. The rest of this post is for people who build or maintain Elementor sites: how to confirm the builder on a site, which builds are live, what ships next to it, and where new sites come from.
